messages:
Maya Patel: Quick sync — CloudPartner (CP) wants to launch a joint webinar + marketplace listing in the same week. Can we map the marketing execution and lead routing this sprint?
Jason Kim: Love it. Proposed week: May 12-16 for webinar, marketplace listing publishes May 14. Keeps momentum.
Leo Chen: Timeline looks ok. We’ll need final webinar brief by EOD Fri (assets, 3 talking points, panel). Who’s owner for the brief?
Maya Patel: Jason can own the brief. Rachel can draft the blog/announcement and marketplace description.
Rachel S: On it. For marketplace listing copy — do we want a performance-focused blurb or platform/integration blurb? I vote performance (latency/cost benchmarks) + 2 example use cases.
Devon Ortiz: Agree. Benchmarks we can highlight: 99th p50 latency, cost per 1k tokens vs baseline, and an example: embeddings index + search demo.
Jason Kim: Panel: Jason (moderator), Leo (tech demo — Dedicated), CP PM (customer story), Maya (opening/positioning). Duration 40 min + 10 Q.
Maya Patel: Marketing asks: 1) webinar brief by Jason; 2) blog + marketplace copy by Rachel; 3) co-branded datasheet (design) by next Wed; 4) lead routing rules + SFDC mapping by Devon.
Devon Ortiz: Drafting lead routing now. Proposed routing: marketplace leads -> Pardot form -> SFDC Lead (Partner Campaign tag) -> Auto-qualify to MQL if demo requested or company size >50 -> Assign to AE queue: "Marketplace AEs" -> notify #sales-inbound and send email to assigned AE.
Jason Kim: Can we include an immediate webhook for hot leads to OpsBot so Growth Ops can triage?
Devon Ortiz: Yep. OpsBot will post to #sales-inbound with lead summary. Example payload: ```{ "utm_source": "cp_marketplace", "campaign": "cp_webinar_may14", "lead_score": 85 }```
Leo Chen: Technical prep checklist for webinar: short live demo (10m) of Redwood Console + Dedicated routing, pre-record fallback, test environment creds, demo dataset (public docs).
Rachel S: Marketplace blurb draft (short): "Redwood Inference — High-performance LLM inference that reduces per-token cost and shortens tail latency. Available as an integration on CloudPartner Marketplace for frictionless deployment and predictable production performance." Thoughts?
Maya Patel: Nice start. Make two variants: 1) short (50-70 chars) for headline, 2) longer ~280 chars for the listing body + one CTA.
Rachel S: Got it. Drafting now. Also prepping two LinkedIn post options (product-led vs customer-story).
Jason Kim: For webinar registration page copy — include 3 bullets: what you'll learn (benchmarks + infra tips), who should attend (platform/ML/infra), and what they'll walk away with (playbook + replay).
Devon Ortiz: Routing note: ensure leads from marketplace with "trial" flag skip nurture and go straight to demo AE queue. Also tag partner source for revenue attribution.
Maya Patel: Legal: need CP logo approval for co-branded assets by Mon. Rachel, ping legal and drop attachments in #marketing-ops.
Rachel S: @LegalLoop pinged. Uploaded first draft to the drive: https://drive.redwood/marketing/cp-co-marketing.
OpsBot: Deploy reminder: Webinar landing page scheduled to go live on 1912347400. Automated reminder 48h before. :bell:
Jason Kim: One more — analytics: set UTM params for all CTAs: utm_source=cp_marketplace, utm_medium=marketplace, utm_campaign=cp_webinar_may14. Use that to join SFDC campaign.
Leo Chen: Also capture variant param for copy A/B: ?variant=product_vs_story
Maya Patel: Great. Action items recap: Jason -> webinar brief by Fri; Rachel -> blog + marketplace copy + legal ping; Devon -> SFDC routing + OpsBot webhook config; Leo -> demo checklist + fallback video. We'll reconvene Tue morning to review assets.
Jason Kim: I'll post the brief draft in this thread when ready.
Rachel S: Will share drafts and copies in #marketing for quick reviews.
Devon Ortiz: I'll drop the SFDC field mappings here once I finish.
Maya Patel: Thanks team — let’s keep this lean. :rocket:
